name: Stained Blade
summary:
# PHYSICAL MELEE AGAINST REAL PLAYERS
Stained Blade delivers true physics-based multiplayer melee combat in a competitive multiplayer environment where skill and practice matter. Weapons react realistically to contact, and no two weapons are handled the same way.
